profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit AI safety and research company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company's primary product is Claude, described on its site as an AI built for problem solvers, intended to help users tackle complex challenges, analyze data, and write code. Anthropic also offers the Anthropic Console, a developer-facing API management platform with tools for prompt testing, evaluation, usage monitoring, and cost controls, as well as Claude Code, an agentic coding tool, and a Computer Use agent capable of desktop automation and high-privilege system operations.

Anthropic faces substantial litigation exposure, with 12 cases tracked across multiple federal courts including the Northern District of California, the District of Delaware, the District of Hawaii, the District of Vermont, the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, and the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Cases include suits brought by individual plaintiffs such as Brunell, Gribble, Patel, Smith, Pascual, Shakespeare, Kahn, Haugland, and Grossinger, as well as a case filed by Edelson, PC and one brought by the University of Tennessee Research Foundation. The site's records associate 181 California law data points with the company's legal profile.
